meta.title: Franklin Martinez, AI Engineer
meta.description: Franklin Martinez builds LLM systems and measures them before trusting them: justask, docmatch and dgii-ts, with live figures and the numbers behind them.

hero.title: I build AI that knows when it's unsure.

justask.lead: Turns what a person types into an app's own state: a search result, a table filter, a filled record card. Code finds the candidates, a model picks one label per question with a probability for every label, and a field it isn't sure of stays empty for the person to fill (Fig. 1).
justask.m_held: unclear requests left for the person
justask.m_cap: a day in model spend, the demo's cap

docmatch.lead: Invoice reconciliation for accounts payable. A vision model reads the invoice, deterministic code checks what it read and matches it against the purchase order and the receiving record, and anything that doesn't add up goes to a person (Fig. 2). The deep dive has the benchmark behind every stage.
docmatch.status: In progress: extraction, matching, entity resolution and the review pipeline are done.
docmatch.note_ci: A CI gate fails any pull request that lowers field or line-item F1.
docmatch.m_p95: from upload to approval, for 95% of invoices
docmatch.m_cost: per invoice, about a quarter of a cent
docmatch.run: See it run: an invoice checked step by step

dgii.lead: A TypeScript library for the DGII, the Dominican tax authority. It validates RNC, cédula, NCF and e-NCF numbers offline, and looks up taxpayers by scraping DGII's web pages with retries and a circuit breaker, because DGII has no public API and shut down its SOAP service in January 2025. Fig. 3 is the library itself, running in this page.
dgii.note_skill: It ships an agent skill, so coding agents learn the library with one command:
dgii.m_cedulas: real cédulas that fail the check-digit rule and still pass
dgii.run: See it run: check an RNC or a cédula yourself

domiprop.lead: Rental management for Dominican landlords: expense tracking, the monthly 606 purchase report, lease contracts under Ley 85-25, and reminders before tax deadlines. Built with Next.js, NestJS, Prisma and PostgreSQL. Pre-launch.
domiprop.caption: Fig. 4. The DomiProp dashboard.

brook.lead: A mobile app in development (Expo, TypeScript) that turns the links people save from TikTok, Instagram and the web into a searchable library, each link sorted into typed fields with a confidence badge.

fig1.label: Fig. 1
fig1.caption: Three requests sent to the live demo on October 11, 2026, replayed with their real responses. Bars are the model's probability for each pick; a pick below its gate leaves the field empty.
fig1.empty_why: No vendor is named. Best vendor guess: {name} at {p}.
fig1.intro: justask is my open-source library. Type a request and it fills the form, leaving blank anything it isn't sure of. Pick a request to see it work.

fig2.label: Fig. 2
fig2.caption: A synthetic invoice from docmatch's CI corpus, with its labeled fields drawn where they sit on the page, then the gate's two rules. The gate needs no model and no label. A reading that fails is kept and never retried, because retrying would shop for a passing answer.
fig2.totals_detail: Not checkable: the invoice shows no amount due, and an unreadable or absent value never fails a rule
fig2.verdict: Verdict: passed, one rule checked and none failed
fig2.next: Next: resolve each line to the catalog, then match the invoice against its purchase order and receiving record.

fig3.label: Fig. 5
fig3.caption: Three extraction backends on a fixed subset of 100 pinned documents. Each row links the commit that produced it.

fig4.label: Fig. 3
fig4.caption: dgii-ts 0.3.0 from npm, imported by this page. The steps show the check-digit arithmetic; the verdict is the library's own. The example numbers are invented.
fig4.input: An RNC, cédula, NCF or e-NCF
fig4.waiting: Type a number, or pick an example.
fig4.rnc_rule: RNC: digits 1 to 8 times weights 7, 9, 8, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. The remainder of the sum over 11 gives the check digit.
fig4.cedula_rule: Cédula: Luhn. Digits 1 to 10 alternate weights 1 and 2, products over 9 lose 9, and the check digit tops the sum up to a multiple of 10.
fig4.ncf_rule: NCF and e-NCF carry no check digit: the library checks the series letter, the type code and the length.
fig4.whitelist: The library accepts this number from its list of known numbers that break the algorithm.

method.title: How I work
method.rules: When a model makes a decision in something I build, I write down how it will be judged before the first call: a frozen eval set, pass lines, a gate that is measured rather than guessed. Failed rounds stay in the record.
method.brief_title: From a brief to a shipped product.
method.brief: Research and a plan go in, and a working product with a QA guide comes out: the data model, the API, and an interface that people without a technical background can use.
method.tooling: Every repo carries written rules and edit hooks, so each change typechecks, lints and validates its schema before it lands. Deep models plan, fast models execute, and the same rules hold both.
